name: @chaoticgoodcomputing/quartz-email-subscribe
description: Quartz 5 component: a Buttondown newsletter subscribe box. See README.md and CONTEXT.md.
//exports: Every entry has its type declarations beside it, which build.mjs emits: Quartz's generated plugin index skips a package without dist/index.d.ts, and a TypeScript site imports the types from them. ./package.json is how Quartz reads the manifest (import.meta.resolve).
//peerDependencies: The host Quartz's own copies, never bundled or installed here: the component's vnodes must be the host's Preact's. The types are imported for types only.
//devDependencies: Build-time only: esbuild bundles dist/, and @chaoticgoodcomputing/css-check checks the stylesheet against ADR-0003 before it ships (build.mjs). @chaoticgoodcomputing/declarations writes the .d.ts beside each entry. The libraries are `workspace:*` specs, which `pnpm publish` rewrites to the published version (ADR-0005).

quartz.name: cgc-email-subscribe
quartz.description: A newsletter subscribe box that posts to Buttondown.

defaultOptions.title: Newsletter
defaultOptions.description: Weekly updates about any new notes!
